text:
Sam: Heads-up — seeing ~20-40% step latency regression on 8-node TP+DP runs after last runtime change. Symptoms: all-reduce stalls on cross-rack links and KV-cache eviction spikes.

Raj: Can you paste the perf profile + the exact run config?

Sam: Pasting trimmed profiler output and job config snapshot: 
```
job: redwood-eval/8node-tp-dp
model: gpt-xxl
seq_len: 128
batch_size_per_gpu: 2
flags: {batch_ms:12, kv_cache_prefetch:false}

profiling summary:
allreduce_wait_ms: 38.2
kernel_select_fallbacks: 14
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.27
avg_step_latency_ms: 482
comm_vs_compute_overlap: 0.12
```

Priya: I looked at the runtime logs — kernel selector is choosing a fallback quant kernel on machines that don't have NVLink (PCIe-only). That kernel serializes more and prevents good comm/compute overlap.

Sam: Example selector log: 
```
[KernelSelector] layer=attn0 selected=quant8_fallback reason=topology_no_nvlink pci_penalty=1.6
[Runtime] comm_streams=1 kv_prefetch=false
```

Jorge: Two quick ideas: 1) prefer comm-overlap-capable kernels when topology indicates cross-rack TP (even if slightly more FLOPs). 2) for short sequences, reduce batch_ms to lower tail latency and avoid big KV thrash. Eg: 
```json
{"batch_ms": 6, "kernel_preference": ["comm_overlap", "latency_opt"], "kv_prefetch": true}
```

Nikhil: From infra side — those 8-node clusters are mixed fabric. In-rack links are NVLink/PCIe bridges, cross-rack uses EFA but sometimes falls back to ibverbs path due to MTU/route quirks. We should do topology-aware aggregation: reduce cross-rack allreduce fan-in by doing an in-rack reduce then cross-rack tree.

perf-bot: :warning: Regression alert: job redwood-eval/8node-tp-dp exceeded SLO on 2026-11-02. Trace: https://console.redwood.ai/perf/trace/abc123. Comm wait spike correlated with kernel_selector fallback.

Sam: I prototyped Jorge's kernel hinting locally: results on a 8-node replica (same model): 
```
before: allreduce_wait_ms=38.2 avg_step=482
after:  allreduce_wait_ms=9.1  avg_step=395  (~-18%)
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.27 -> 0.12
comm_compute_overlap: 0.12 -> 0.58
```

Priya: Nice. Also KV thrash looks aligned to batch boundaries — when a batch straddles a shard boundary we get high eviction. I'm going to prototype deterministic KV prefetch + soft reservation of next shard for cross-node TP.

Nikhil: I'll open a fabric router PR to prefer in-rack aggregation + attach topology hints to job metadata. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2234

Jorge: Action items: 
- (Sam) run A/B with kernel_hint enabled across 3 different rack topologies by EOD tomorrow
- (Priya) prototype KV prefetch patch and run small regressions
- (Nikhil) land routing PR and add unit tests
- (Raj) collect a matrix of NVLink vs PCIe vs EFA paths and their observed allreduce latency

Sam: Cool. Putting a short note on the incident board and tagging eng-runtime-oncall. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Raj: lgtm, will add the matrix rows.
